# W=1 and sparse warnings that CI accepts for now.
#
# Everything in this list needs a logic change to fix, so it is left for
# Phase 2 (see "Known issues for Phase 2" in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Any
# warning not matched here fails the "Extra warnings and sparse" CI step.
#
# One POSIX extended regex per line, matched against the warning line with
# the checkout directory stripped. Line/column numbers are wildcarded so
# unrelated edits do not invalidate an entry.

# kstrtol() is __must_check and its result is never looked at; checking it
# changes what a malformed procfs write does.
^unisocwcn/platform/wcn_procfs.c:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: warning: variable .ret. set but not used \[-Wunused-but-set-variable\]$

# eth->h_proto (network order) is compared with host-order ETH_P_IP /
# ETH_P_IPV6, so the test is always true on little-endian; the fix changes
# which broadcast frames are looped back in AP mode.
^unisocwifi/txrx.c:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: warning: restricted __be16 degrades to integer$

# Firmware protocol structs with a flexible array of structs that themselves
# end in a flexible array; needs the accessors rewritten.
^unisocwifi/rx_msg.h:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: warning: array of flexible structures$
^unisocwifi/vendor.h:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: warning: array of flexible structures$
